notes.title: Utopia Process will be Free!
notes.notes:
Hey all.  Thank you for all the wishlists and support.  Utopia Process will now be free. Give it about a week for Steam to process the change. 

I knew the game wouldn't be a massive financial success, but any semblance of attention has disappeared. Now I just want people to be able to play the game. If you haven't played it yet, enjoy! If you have, thank you from the bottom of my heart! 

You may want a refund if you paid for the game. If so, I don't see anyone over the 2 hour mark for this game, so there should be no issues requesting your refund through Steam. 

I'm working on my next project, but I don't have anything to show yet. Definitely follow the socials linked below if you want to see what's next ^^

notes.title: High Visibility Font and Steam keys on Itch
notes.notes:
Hey y'all.  Just a quick update with a few things. 

You now have the ability to toggle a more easily read font for small text in Utopia Process. It clashes a bit with the art style, but if you've had issues reading the narrative end cards or menu options, this should help. 

Additionally, you can buy Utopia Process on Itch and get official Steam keys.  If you prefer Itch or just want to give me a better cut, feel free to buy over there and redeem your code!

Lastly, make sure to wishlist Utopia Process if you haven't already. I plan to add a few final features to Utopia Process to coincide with the Steam Summer Sale.  By wishlisting, you'll be able to see those updates and know when Utopia Process goes on sale!

Thank you so much for reading and I'll talk to ya'll again in June!

notes.title: Launch sale is over. Thank you all!
notes.notes:
With the launch week of Utopia Process officially over, I really wanted to start by saying [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who bought, played, wishlisted, or even glanced at Utopia Process.  It kept my soul in my body during 2020 and let me share something that I hope ya'll find interesting, warts and all. 

[b]Now about those warts...[/b]

The most common issue I've seen players deal with this week has been difficulty reading smaller text.  I'm going to update the colors of small text for higher visibility within the next two weeks.  Thank you to everyone who has let me know.

For bigger changes, I will be waiting until June.  There are some quality of life changes that have been eating at me that I want to get implemented before the Summer Sale. While I don't want to over promise, I'm looking at a few different things I can add.  I've divided them into definites and maybes:

[b]Definitely:[/b]
[list]
[*]Better tutorial text
[*]Expanded score tracking
[/list]
[b]Maybe:[/b]
[list]
[*]Extra music
[*]Online leaderboards
[*]Remixed enemy behavior
[*]Extra Modes
[/list]

Once again, if it's in the "maybe" list, do not treat it as a promise.  I'm looking into it and I have to try and fit these in between a day job and work on other games.  

Once again THANK YOU SO MUCH for all the support during the launch of my first game and keep an eye out for future sale prices and updates.

-Jo
